entry.title: Tropix 0.1.2
entry.summary: **Tropix 0.1.2** for Akai MPC standalone devices (native ARM VST2). Tested on an MPC Live II (first generation), MPC OS 3.10. - **SETTINGS:** A4 tuning, transpose, bend range, polyphony, velocity and stereo spread are now full-size knobs: touch one and drag, or turn the data wheel. entry.title: Tropix 0.1.1
entry.summary: Island and afro sounds - 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music. Two layers, glide, scoop, vibrato, filter, drive, chorus, delay, reverb, nine colorways. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). entry.title: Tropix 0.1.0
entry.summary: First release of **Tropix**, an island and afro ROMpler for Akai MPC standalone devices (native ARM VST2, MPC OS 3.x). Tested on an MPC Live II, MPC OS 3.9.1. - **128 presets**, browsed by genre (afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae, Hawaiian) and type (keys, guitars, horns, steel pan, mallets, bass, percussion, synths & FX); also in MPC's own PRESET list - **65 instruments** from redistributable recordings (CC0, CC BY 3.0, University of Iowa MIS) and original synthesis: steel pans, amapiano
